Elasticsearch 8.15.3, self-hosted in Docker on the benchmark host.
Single node, one primary shard, zero replicas, 1 GiB fixed JVM heap.
Text uses Elasticsearch's standard analyzer with stemming and stop-word removal disabled.
Timed TOP_K requests disable _source, stored fields, and exact total-hit counting.
The completed index is refreshed and force-merged to one segment before queries.
